ctaHeading: Albion's fencing team is ready — let's secure your property.
aboutText: Defensive Maintenance & Fencing has been serving Albion and Melbourne's west with premium, secure access solutions. We specialise in building durable gates and handrails using 100% Australian-made materials. Our focus is on providing seamless functionality with security, especially for industrial walkways where safety and stability are the top priorities.
servicesText: We design, fabricate, and install a range of custom fencing and access solutions. From residential gates to industrial handrails, we focus on durable, secure, and functional outcomes using high-quality local materials.

services.title: Custom Gates
services.desc: Bespoke pedestrian and driveway gates engineered for security and seamless access.
